import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots to show comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_order = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts().index.tolist()
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='Sleep Disorder', style='Sleep Disorder', s=100, alpha=0.6, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best', framealpha=0.9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Disorders
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(sleep_disorder_counts))
ax2.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index, 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level by BMI Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level', 
                hue='BMI Category', size='Heart Rate', sizes=(50, 300), alpha=0.6, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
occupation_sleep.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax4, color='steelblue')
ax4.set_title('Avg Sleep Duration\nby Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hours', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('')
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=8)
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Sleep Quality by Age Group and Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
age_gender_quality = df.groupby(['Age Group', 'Gender'])['Quality of Sleep'].mean().unstack()
age_gender_quality.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax5.set_title('Avg Sleep Quality by\nAge Group & Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax5.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=9)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Daily Steps vs Sleep Duration
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
sns.regplot(data=df, x='Daily Steps', y='Sleep Duration', scatter_kws={'alpha':0.4}, 
            line_kws={'color':'red', 'linewidth':2}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Sleep Duration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.violinplot(data=df, y='Sleep Disorder Filled', x='Heart Rate', ax=ax7, palette='muted')
ax7.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution\nby Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('')
ax7.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)
ax7.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
